thought.text: There's a `/desktop` route for the new Vue/Vite frontend. Let me test it with an authenticated session — this will exercise the Vite dev server asset compilation.

reasoning_content:
The `/desktop` route exists. This is the new Vue/Vite frontend. Let's test that. This will verify that the Vite pipeline is actually working (asset compilation, which the guide says takes several minutes on the first launch).

Let's try fetching `/desktop` with an authenticated session.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== GET /desktop (authenticated) ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/desk.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/desktop
echo "--- title & vite script tags ---"
grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/desk.html
grep -oE "<script[^>]*src=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*>" /tmp/desk.html | head
grep -oE "<link[^>]*href=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*>" /tmp/desk.html | head
' 2>&1
